segments.an6.45:2.1: “Yampi, bhikkhave, daliddo [daḷiddo (sī.)] assako anāḷhiko [anaddhiko (syā. kaṃ.)] iṇaṃ ādiyati, iṇādānampi, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino”ti?
segments.an6.45:3.1: “Yampi, bhikkhave, daliddo assako anāḷhiko iṇaṃ ādiyitvā vaḍḍhiṃ paṭissuṇāti, vaḍḍhipi, bhikkhave, dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino”ti?
segments.an6.45:4.1: “Yampi, bhikkhave, daliddo assako anāḷhiko vaḍḍhiṃ paṭissuṇitvā kālābhataṃ [kālagataṃ (ka.)] vaḍḍhiṃ na deti, codentipi naṃ;
segments.an6.45:5.1: “Yampi, bhikkhave, daliddo assako anāḷhiko codiyamāno na deti, anucarantipi naṃ;
segments.an6.45:6.1: “Yampi, bhikkhave, daliddo assako anāḷhiko anucariyamāno na deti, bandhantipi naṃ;
segments.an6.45:7.1: “Iti kho, bhikkhave, dāliddiyampi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino, iṇādānampi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino, vaḍḍhipi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino, codanāpi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino, anucariyāpi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino, bandhanampi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino;
segments.an6.45:7.2: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, hirī natthi kusalesu dhammesu, ottappaṃ natthi kusalesu dhammesu, vīriyaṃ natthi kusalesu dhammesu, paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye daliddo assako anāḷhiko.
segments.an6.45:8.1: “Sa kho so, bhikkhave, daliddo assako anāḷhiko saddhāya asati kusalesu dhammesu, hiriyā asati kusalesu dhammesu, ottappe asati kusalesu dhammesu, vīriye asati kusalesu dhammesu, paññāya asati kusalesu dhammesu, kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
segments.an6.45:9.1: “So tassa kāyaduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati [padahati (ka.)].
segments.an6.45:9.2: ‘Mā maṃ jaññū’ti icchati,‘mā maṃ jaññū’ti saṅkappati,‘mā maṃ jaññū’ti vācaṃ bhāsati,‘mā maṃ jaññū’ti kāyena parakkamati. So tassa vacīduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu … pe … so tassa manoduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu … pe …‘mā maṃ jaññū’ti kāyena parakkamati.
segments.an6.45:11.1: “Tamenaṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā vippaṭisārasahagatā pāpakā akusalavitakkā samudācaranti.
segments.an6.45:12.1: “Sa kho so, bhikkhave, daliddo assako anāḷhiko kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā nirayabandhane vā bajjhati tiracchānayonibandhane vā.
segments.an6.45:12.2: Nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekabandhanampi samanupassāmi evaṃdāruṇaṃ evaṃkaṭukaṃ [evaṃdukkhaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] evaṃantarāyakaraṃ anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya, yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayabandhanaṃ vā tiracchānayonibandhanaṃ vā”ti.
segments.an6.45:19.3: Gāme vā yadi vāraññe, yassa vippaṭisārajā.
segments.an6.45:27.1: “Tassa sammā vimuttassa, ñāṇaṃ ce hoti tādino;

lines: Vaḍḍhiṃ paṭissuṇātīti dātuṃ asakkonto vaḍḍhiṃ dassāmīti paṭijānāti.
Anucarantipi nanti parisamajjhagaṇamajjhādīsu ātapaṭhapanapaṃsuokiraṇādīhi vippakāraṃ pāpento pacchato pacchato anubandhanti.
Cāgo puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatīti cāgoti saṅkhaṃ gataṃ puññaṃ vaḍḍhati.
Ekodi nipako satoti ekaggacitto kammassakatañāṇasatīhi ca samannāgato.
Evaṃ ñatvā yathābhūtanti evaṃ ettakaṃ kāraṇaṃ yathāsabhāvaṃ jānitvā.
Sammā cittaṃ vimuccatīti idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – sabbasaṃyojanakkhayasaṅkhāte nibbāne sabbaso anupādiyitvā sammā hetunā nayena maggacittaṃ vimuccati.
“Etaṃ ñatvā yathābhūtaṃ, sabbasaṃyojanakkhayan” tipi pāḷiyaṃ likhitaṃ, tassa etaṃ sabbasaṃyojanakkhayasaṅkhātaṃ nibbānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñatvāti attho.
Tassa sammā vimuttassāti tassa sammā vimuttassa khīṇāsavassa.
Etaṃ kho paramaṃ ñāṇanti etaṃ maggaphalañāṇaṃ paramañāṇaṃ nāma.
Āṇaṇyamuttamanti sabbesaṃ aṇaṇānaṃ khīṇāsavo uttamaaṇaṇo, tasmā arahattaphalaṃ āṇaṇyamuttamanti arahattaphalena desanāya kūṭaṃ gaṇhi.
Imasmiñca sutte vaṭṭameva kathetvā gāthāsu vaṭṭavivaṭṭaṃ kathitanti.
45-48. Tatiye daliddo nāma duggato, tassa bhāvo dāliddiyaṃ.
“Buddho dhammo saṅgho”ti vutte “sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto dhammo, suppaṭipanno saṅgho”ti kenaci akampiyabhāvena okappanaṃ ratanattayaguṇe ogāhetvā kappanaṃ okappanasaddhā nāma.
“Idaṃ akusalaṃ kammaṃ no sakaṃ, idaṃ pana kammaṃ sakan”ti evaṃ byatirekato anvayato ca kammassakatajānanapaññā kammassakatapaññā.
Tividhañhi duccaritaṃ attanā katampi sakakammaṃ nāma na hoti atthabhañjanato.
Hirimano etassāti hirimanoti āha “hirisampayuttacitto”ti, pāpajigucchanalakkhaṇāya hiriyā sampayuttacittoti attho.
Ottappati ubbijjati bhāyati sīlenāti ottappī, ottappena samannāgato.
Upekkhanti catutthajjhānupekkhaṃ, na yaṃ kiñci upekkhāvedananti āha “catutthajjhānupekkhan”ti.
Yo gaṇasaṅgaṇikaṃ vinodetvā catūsu iriyāpathesu aṭṭhaārambhavatthuvasena ekako hoti, tassa kāyikaṃ vīriyaṃ āraddhaṃ nāma hoti.
Gamane uppannakilesassa ṭhānaṃ pāpuṇituṃ na deti, ṭhāne uppannakilesassa nisajjaṃ, nisajjāya uppannakilesassa sayanaṃ pāpuṇituṃ na deti, uppannaṭṭhāneyeva kilese niggaṇhāti.
Ayaṃ cetasikaṃ vīriyaṃ āraddhaṃ nāma hoti.
Paṭipakkhadūrībhāvena seṭṭhaṭṭhena ca eko udetīti ekodi, ekaggatā.
Paṭipakkhato attānaṃ nipāti, taṃ vā nipayati visosetīti nipako.
Aññataraṃ kāyādibhedaṃ ārammaṇaṃ sātisayāya satiyā saratīti sato.
Akuppā me vimuttīti mayhaṃ arahattaphalavimutti akuppatāya akuppārammaṇatāya ca akuppā.
Sā hi rāgādīhi na kuppatīti akuppatāyapi akuppā.
Imāni hi satte bhavesu saṃyojenti upanibandhanti bhavābhavena saṃyojenti, tasmā bhavasaṃyojanānīti vuccanti.
Aññe hi sattā yāva na kilesā pahīyanti, tāva saiṇā nāma aserivihārabhāvato.
